title: Unit Event — Start Rolling! Stars' Crossing

meta.Outline: The Lumina Grand Prix has come at last. The preliminary stage will take place in a specially-built glamorous accommodation facility! A nervous Minori throws herself into life on camera alongside a colorful array of rivals, but she soon meets hurdles.

rows.Line: Lumina Grand Prix - Day One

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...! Th-This place is huge...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...!
I didn't realize the training camp for the grand prix would be taking place at such a big facility...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were told during orientation that they'll be filming us for a month during the prelim stage as we attend a special training camp...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this place feels more like a five-star hotel than a training camp.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're right.
They must have an enormous budget for this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm starting to get really excited!
I can't believe we get to stay in such an amazing place and have delicious food here every day...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're as happy-go-lucky as ever, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But this isn't all fun and games. You can't let your guard down! Remember how everything during the prelim stage is gonna be streamed?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh... R-Right...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it's not just the prelim stage. They're going to stream what we do day to day during this training camp. In that sense, this really is an unprecedented program...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ms. Arisawa did say that she wants to see who we are as idols...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's hard not to get anxious when you know that you're going to be in front of a camera the entire day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Ohh, now I'm starting to feel really nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, you're all over the place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But they also said how they won't show us leaving to go to school or attending to other offers, so maybe we'll be able to take breathers then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... How do you think this competition's gonna go? What if they have us do a dance battle or something...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We can't rule that out...
But we won't know until the time actually comes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At this point, basically all we've been told is that twenty-four groups are supposed to be here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Twenty-four groups...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Winning the grand prix means becoming the top group out of all of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But first, let's focus on clearing the prelim stage and progressing to the final stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's not only going to be broadcast on TV, but also streamed on NetParadise.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A ton of people are going to be watching, so it could really increase our work offers if we do well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right.
Our goal for the time being will be to make it to the final stage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have to stay alive if we want to keep moving forward as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...! We can't give anyone an inch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm a little worried since we still don't actually know what they're gonna have us do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you guys taught me all about how to be a better dancer and talker! So whatever it is, I plan on making full use of my training to pull through!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's go out there and throw everything we have at this competition!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
The Lumina Forum - Ballroom

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
We're not supposed to meet for another thirty minutes, but the other groups are already here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess we're all just that motivated...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
<Good morning, everyone.
Thank you all very much for gathering here so early.>

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: <Our apologies, but we're still running some sound tests. I hope you'll bear with us until everything is in order.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Sound tests...?
They may not be ready for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Why don't we look over those papers again in the meantime...?

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <Good morning, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, it's Ms. Arisawa...!

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <Now that all our groups appear to be here, I'd like to explain a little about this facility.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <Thank you all very much once again for deciding to participate in the Lumina Grand Prix.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <And welcome to the Lumina Forum.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <This training camp, the Lumina Forum, was built specifically for the Lumina Grand Prix to serve you idols.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What...?!
This whole place was built just for the grand prix...?!

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <Thanks to NetParadise's support, we have been able to assemble everything that you will need to shine as idols.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <The rehearsal room has an extensive selection of exercise machines. We even have a cafeteria with a menu of healthy dishes that a certified nutritionist helped develop, which should help you all stay fit as fiddles.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <There are also other facilities that you'll be able to use for your activities, including a stream studio, meeting rooms, a massage room and an archive room.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <Please feel free to use everything that the Lumina Forum has to offer. I hope you're all able to take advantage of them.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's space to train, eat, stream and have meetings... In other words...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Isn't this basically an evolved version of the MORE MORE HOUSE...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You might be right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is it possible that the MORE MORE HOUSE was Ms. Arisawa's test run for this...?)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <That concludes my explanation regarding this facility. Please feel free to ask the staff if you have any questions.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <Now... Oh, before I forget, there's something important I need to tell all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something important...?

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <The winning group of the grand prix will be awarded some prize money...>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <But they will also be given a small gift from me.>

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: A gift?

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <That will be revealed when the final results are announced, but I'm sure you'll be pleasantly surprised...>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <I hope you all do your best moving forward to become the winners.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A small gift...?
What could it be?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really can't say.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Based on the scale of this program, I've gotta think it's the opposite of small...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there's no point thinking about it right now. That'd be like counting your chickens before they've hatched.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We need to channel all of our energy into this current moment.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
We're all set to go now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'll excuse myself here.>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to seeing all of you shine, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's finally starting...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(We've gotta do our best here!
We need to spread as much hope as we can from here so that MORE MORE JUMP! can get closer to achieving its dream!)
The Lumina Forum - Ballroom

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Look at all the cameras...!
I don't think I've seen so many in one place before...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And these giant monitors...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<When's the stream starting?>
<In about a minute, right?>
<Oh man, I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's set up so we can see our viewers' comments in real time.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They weren't kidding. Everything from here on out is gonna be streamed...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(No...
Now's not the time to be feeling nervous!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to do my best for the sake of MORE MORE JUMP! For the sake of our dream!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Okay, we roll in...!
Five, four...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, this day has finally arrived!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Idols... They are the lights which illuminate their fans' hearts.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Which group is going to shine the brightest and spread the most hope?!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: The world's first battle to see which idols stand on top is about to commence!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: The Lumina Grand Prix starts now!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's begun!>
<Yes! Finally!>
<Go Cheerful * Days!>

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: We're already getting a flood of comments!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: All of the comments you post are going to appear on the hundred monitors we've set up around the training camp.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Our idols will be watching closely, so please keep sending us your thoughts!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We see your comments, you guys!
Don't be afraid to send so many that you overload the system♪

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Your words are a huge source of encouragement for us. Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, all of the idols here are watching?!>
<I just went from total excitement to total disbelief.>
<I'm rooting for you! Break a leg out there!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Airi and Tsubaki are already leaving an impression! That's so amazing of them...!)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: And I, Ayane Koizumi, AKA Aya-P, will be your MC! We hope that you'll stay with us until the very end!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Now, I'll start explaining the rules for the prelim stage!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
They're actually very simple!
For the next month, our idols will be spending their time here at the Lumina Forum however they like.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: On the final day, we'll decide who gets to advance to the final stage by judging what you all look like after a month!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Just based on what we look like after a month...?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I doubt that means we can just sit around and do nothing.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Yes, that's exactly right!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: At random moments throughout this training camp, you will encounter an event called “Lumina Time”!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Lumina Time...?
What's that?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Lumina Time is an event that will take place irregularly where idols will be asked to perform certain tasks.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Each task will be revealed when you actually encounter this event. So, I hope you'll all look forward to seeing what we have in store!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Also, we'll make sure to avoid the times when you have to attend to work and such, so please be reassured!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, we're gonna be asked to do tasks at random... In other words, it's a golden opportunity to make an appeal to everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
(I see...
This Lumina Time seems to be the key to surviving the prelim stage.)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: With the exception of evenings, footage of the Lumina Forum's interior will be constantly streamed on this channel. So, come join us whenever you can!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: In addition, KyoTV will be bringing you a weekly digest each Friday night at nine! We hope you also check that out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Doing well during Lumina Time would very likely mean having a clip shown during that digest...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which will naturally lead to reaching more eyes. That should in turn make it easier to advance.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We still have no idea what they're going to have us do, but we need to stay absolutely focused...)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next, let's talk about how you'll be judged!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
For the prelim stage...!
Guess what?! You'll all be ranked based on our viewers' votes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Us?!>
<Fr?>
<That's so much responsibility!>

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: The goal of the Lumina Grand Prix is to determine which idols are able to spread the most hope.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: In other words, we need to hear from the recipients of that hope. We need to hear from all of you! That is why we're having the viewers vote.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
I see...
That makes a lot of sense.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Furthermore, each viewer will be able to cast two votes! You'll be voting for groups rather than individual idols, and you will not be able to vote for the same group twice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They'll cast one vote for their favorite group, but also have to vote for a different group.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (You can tell they don't want a group's current level of popularity to be the only deciding factor.)

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: And the groups that collect the most votes will advance to the final stage.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: The total number of slots available is―

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Four! Only four groups will advance to the final stage!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so few...!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: This is going to be a tough battle...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Which group is going to stand on top?
You, the viewers, hold the key to answering that question! See for yourself who shines the most!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: When you do feel that you've been given hope, be sure to show that group your support by posting a comment or voting for them!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm gonna have zero time to sleep!>
<I'll be glued to my screen and cheering nonstop!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They all seem really excited...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We need to advance. No matter what.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've finished explaining the rules...

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Next, we'd like to show our idols everything that the Lumina Forum has to offer during the prelim stage!
Corridor

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: First, we'll be showing you all the crown jewel of the Lumina Forum— The rehearsal room!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The rehearsal room...!
We get to see it already!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If what Ms. Arisawa said is right, then it should be pretty extravagant.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm looking forward to seeing what kinds of exercise machines they have.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hey, it's Haruka!>
<I've been a fan since she was in ASRUN.>
<It's always great to see your favorite idol on camera.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(They even have cameras in the corridors...!
Come to think of it, they did say that they'd set them up all around the camp.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I was just amazed by how many cameras there are...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Twenty-four groups are here, so it'd be pretty hard to have camera crews following all of them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For the stream, they're going to cut back and forth between the fifty or so cameras they've set up, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, they're also streaming on their subchannel to make sure everyone gets to see their favorite idols.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Which is so cool!
If I were watching, I'd be showering the showrunners with so much praise!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But on the other hand...
I might be on camera right this second.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to constantly stay in idol mode and spread hope to everyone who might be watching!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We can learn a lot from her example.
Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The rehearsal room's so big!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it is!
We could do a show here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And I think that's the training room over there.
Haruka, I bet you're gonna love...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's amazing...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They have all these state-of-the-art cardio machines...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On top of this wide selection of grippers and belts, they have all these dumbbells... I didn't realize it'd be this well equipped...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, they even have grip strength testers that link to your phone! I've been wanting to try these for so long...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait, Haruka, aren't you getting a little too excited?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Huh? Haruka Kiritani's a fitness nut?>
<Haruka's a total athlete.>
<That's pretty cool. Any protein recommendations?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess my worries were misplaced...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that they're enjoying who Haruka is as a person.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Still, this place really is amazing!
This machine's taller than me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's called a lat pulldown machine.
It's great for working out your back and arms.
You get pretty broad benefits, since you also use your core to maintain proper form.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. You can even do stretches... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tsubaki...?!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for jumping in all of a sudden.
But I also really love working out.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Haha! Chiharu's such a huge fitness demon that she does wall sits whenever she has a free moment!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka's the same!
But she likes to do heel raises!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Then, did you know that Chiharu always uses the stairs instead of the elevator?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-B-But!
Haruka fills her bag with textbooks and does curls with them like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you the one bragging?

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: You also need to settle down, Akari.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But the competition's already begun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It doesn't matter if ReLight is our opponent. We have to try to win!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Right! We're also gonna do everything we can to win!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
I really look up to MORE MORE JUMP!...
But that's also why I want to surpass all of you!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line:
It's not just you we plan on defeating.
Our goal is to shine brighter than anyone and stand on top.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's also our plan!!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Ooh, we're already getting a heated conversation over here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! Aya-P?!
Wait, did you get that all on camera...?

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Yup, we got the whole thing!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's awesome to see these groups together!>
<This reminds me of Idol Lovers.>
<I wanna see you guys talk more!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, they're saying they wanna see us talk more!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is the best part of these kinds of shows since it's pretty rare for different groups to mingle like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Right...!
We have to think about how we can stand out in these sorts of interactions too.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to talk to as many of the other idols as I can, but...)
se_run_women_002_1
Wow! This room's bigger than the Sparkly Shooting Star!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Sparkly Shooting Star...?
The Lumina Forum - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Wait, what's the Sparkly Shooting Star...?
Oh, that's right! The people of Earth don't know♪

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: The Sparkly Shooting Star is the biiig meteor I rode on to get to this planet☆

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hikarin's... Oh, now I remember!)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: I'm Hikarin, the biggest idol in the galaxy☆ My smile has the power to brighten up the entire universe!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: All you reporters out there better get pictures of me now, because I might just end up this competition's dark-horse winner!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I saw her during orientation...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(If I recall, she works all by herself.
So, the fact that she's here is really amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
What you just said doesn't help us at all.
Is it safe to say that you're supposed to be a space alien?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: No, it's not!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
I'm a fairy from Planet Twinkle!
I came here to spread twinkly hope to all of you☆

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Alright, so that's your gimmick.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Nooo!
You're not listening!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: There you go again, Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Those two are really lighting it up...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just look at the comments.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<LOL!>
<I'll remember you, Hikarin!>
<Nice one, Arisa!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
I can't read what they're saying because they're zooming by so fast!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Arisa's so quick-witted.
By being a bit sharp, she was able to highlight Hikarin's character setting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: I have ironclad proof that I'm from Planet Twinkle! Here, take a look at this!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Huh? A certificate of residence?!
Wait, what does this even say...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: It's not written in Japanese... I've never seen letters or symbols like these before.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Well, duh!
That's how you write in Twinklese!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Y-You even came up with your own language...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hikarin also deserves a lot of credit.
She's doing a great job of keeping the conversation going with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's right...! In order to get noticed, you have to know how to keep conversations like this going!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means I need to consciously make an effort there...!)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: No, why won't any of you believe me?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: D-Don't worry, Hikarin! I believe you!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Whaaaat?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, really! I believe in ghosts and monsters!
I even got struck with sleep paralysis just the other day!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
Don't talk about me like I'm some sort of monster!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Uh oh. Minori just dissed Hikarin without realizing it, and scored a clean hit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! N-No, I didn't mean to...!
Uhh... Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Minori's bullying Hikarin lol.>
<Isn't she from MMJ?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Also, did you really suffer from sleep paralysis? I'm actually really afraid of ghosts and monsters...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yes...! That really happened!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: While I was sleeping, I felt this enormous weight come over my body. It was so heavy that I couldn't move at all...!

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: Wait, that's actually really scary...

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Were you okay afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do?!
This conversation was going in a fun direction, but I made things awkward...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I have to turn this around somehow!
Uhh... But what do I say...?!)

rows.Line: And that's how twinkletastic me exploded onto the scene!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Hehe. I know that I'm completely different compared to my old self, but how I came to be is the same...!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: The old Hikarin and the current Hikarin are both jam-packed with twinkly star stuff for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: So, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<She did have a past life.>
<Deep down, she's pretty normal.>
<Great story!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<But it's hard to get into this character when you know the truth.>
<She can say all that wild stuff, but you know that she's actually pretty normal lol.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Shouldn't you have gone with a different character?>
<Yeah, this feels too Showa.>

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Regardless of the situation, it's never easy to change who you are as a person...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But Hikarin decided to go down that path in order to spread hope to as many people as she could.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And yet...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's all from me...!
The end!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: I mean, don't you all wanna hear from your fellow Earthlings? So, Minorin, how about... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
M-Minorin...?!
What's wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?!
Is everything alright, Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm shorry, I...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was just so moved...!!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hikarin, you suffered so much that you ended up having to take a break from what you were doing...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But you overcame all that in order to keep spreading hope to everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That by itself is really amazing.
But you came back shining even brighter.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You worked really, really hard...
And you found the resolve to go through with your decision. Just thinking about that made me...!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Minorin...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hikarin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're such an incredible person!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm officially your fan now!
I promise to support you forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Minoriiiin!!!
Thank you so much!
I'm so happy that Planet Twinkle might go big bang!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing absolutely everything I can to spread twinkly hope to everyone!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes!! And I'll be waiting to be filled with that twinkly hope!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I'll use that energy you give me to try harder and harder and harder!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm starting to tear up.>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it does take a lot of guts to change characters like that.>
<Despite what a lot of people are saying, I think you're really cool.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's amazing how you were able to pick yourself back up the way you did!>
<I'll forever support you, Hikarin!>
<I feel the same way as Minori now!>

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: These comments...

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
I know what they mean...
I also went through a lot when I was young.

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: So, Hikarin, you have my support as well!!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you so much, Ue-P! We should take a trip to Venus together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: We're suddenly that close now?! Or the opposite because Venus's really far away!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've got a twinkly flow going, Minorin, you gotta go next!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? M-Me?!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: You do seem like the right person to go next! So, take it away for us!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: What beliefs drive you as an idol?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do...?!
I got so caught up in everyone else's stories that I totally forgot to come up with my own...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to do what they did.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to tell everyone that's watching right now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What I believe in.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We at MORE MORE JUMP! work every day towards giving everyone hope for a better tomorrow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that's been really, really hard...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially for me since, unlike the others, I didn't have any experience being an idol... And I kept holding them all back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: However―

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's also why I'd like to tell you all this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even someone like me can shine if she works super hard! So, let's all keep doing our best together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And because I know that I've been able to spread hope to some of you out there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to never ever give up!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're going to make our dream come true no matter what!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh...
So, to summarize, I'm driven by...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Don't you think you're using up a little too much time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! I-I'm really sorry!!
U-Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We heard your message loud and clear.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Just look at the comments!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm able to keep trying because of you, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I kinda had a hard time watching her because she kept swinging and missing, but she seems like a hardworking girl.>
<She's so straightforward...>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I was so moved by your tears.>
<Her crying all of a sudden kinda startled me lol.>
<MMJ's enthusiastic optimism is what makes them so great!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: That concludes our very first Lumina Time!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: I hope you'll all stick around to see how the rest of the Lumina Grand Prix unfolds!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's finally over...

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Nice work, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Tsubaki! Nice work to you as well!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much for helping me keep each conversation going! You were a huge help!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Likewise.
I was able to enjoy things until the very end because of your brilliant energy.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Yes, you did save us there in the end.
So, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Thank you as well!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Cheerful * Days Member
rows.Line:
You were amazing out there, Arisa!
Our leader gets the job done, huh?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Of course I was amazing.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Line: Oh, there she goes...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, see you later!

rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Line:

Was I able to promote us okay?

rows.Line: Yes, I think you were able to explain to everyone watching who you are as a person and who we are as a group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it wasn't just the comments. People are saying good things on social media too! Through you, they're showing a lot of interest in us now.

rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
Miinoorin!
Huggy-snuggy-wuggy!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wah! Hikarin?!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Thank you so much for what you did back there, Minorin!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, don't thank me!
All I did was say what I felt!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
That's what made me so happy☆

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: The thing is, you gave me hope for a better tomorrow...!

rows.Line: So, Minorin, this ordinary girl decided to become your fan too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hikarin...

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Let's make the most of the time we have left here☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, did you just call yourself...?

rows.Line: I can fly wherever I want using my twinkle-twinkle powers☆ Wh-Wh-Wh-Whoosh!

rows.Line:

You managed to spread hope to a rival.

rows.Line: But I also felt that I need to keep trying even harder moving forward...

rows.Line: After hearing about what drives everyone today, I was reminded of why they're all so amazing.

rows.Line:
And I get to compete against them!
I have to make the most of this opportunity by growing so that I can face them with my head held high!
